findings.title: RC6 report metadata remains bound to RC5 artifact paths
findings.impact: The biological and QC report outputs cannot be independently established as the reviewed RC6 outputs from report_metadata.json; this weakens provenance for biological conclusions and violates the required clean reviewed-evidence binding.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_metadata.json:16-19 references audits/evidence/v571_rc5_candidate/report/01_biological_results.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_metadata.json:34-36 references audits/evidence/v571_rc5_candidate/report/02_quality_control.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate or correct report_metadata.json in a superseding audit run so every biological and QC artifact reference resolves to the RC6 candidate and is content-hashed against the reviewed commit.

limitations: Only two complete representative specimens are included in the retained sensitivity artifact, one per group; the evidence does not establish a biological group effect.
No full image-stack execution was performed, per instruction.
Biological validity of segmentation boundaries and morphology labels still requires independent biological review or manual-mask comparison.
recommended_follow_up: Correct the RC6 report metadata artifact paths and rerun the provenance and report-consistency checks.
Obtain independent biological-validity review of representative short, long, wide, thin, curved, fragmented-looking, fused-looking, single-slice, and low-ratio cases.
